frames.told:
Berthier: “The Emperor watched this field. Reinforcements from Davout, Lannes, Murat and Napoleon bolstered Ney's position — though Bernadotte never arrived, Sire.”
Mack: "A temporary derangement of the arithmetic. Vienna will understand."
